title: Gradient Boosting for Efficient Rank Discovery in Tensor Network Kernel Machines
abstract: arXiv:2611.08093v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Tensor network kernel machines (TNKMs) combine nonlinear features with low-rank tensor representations to model complex relationships efficiently. However, selecting an appropriate tensor rank remains challenging, as conventional rank-search methods require training multiple candidate models, increasing computational costs. In this work, we focus on a canonical polyadic (CP) tensor network parameterization and propose GB-CPKM, a gradient boosting framework that builds a higher-capacity predictor by sequentially adding fixed-rank learners. This approach provides a new perspective on rank selection by incrementally increasing model capacity, with ensemble size selected based on validation performance rather than through explicit rank search. Experiments on real-world regression benchmarks show that GB-CPKM trains up to 6x faster and uses up to 2x less peak memory than a conventional rank-selection method based on cross-validation, while

translated_title: 梯度提升用于张量网络核机器中的高效秩发现
translated_abstract: 张量网络核机器（TNKMs）将非线性特征与低秩张量表示相结合，以高效地建模复杂关系。然而，选择合适的张量秩仍然具有挑战性，因为传统的秩搜索方法需要训练多个候选模型，从而增加了计算成本。在本工作中，我们聚焦于规范多线性（CP）张量网络参数化，并提出GB-CPKM——一种梯度提升框架，通过顺序添加固定秩的学习器来构建更高容量的预测器。该方法通过增量式增加模型容量，为秩选择提供了新的视角：集成规模基于验证性能来选择，而无需进行显式的秩搜索。在真实世界回归基准上的实验表明，与基于交叉验证的传统秩选择方法相比，GB-CPKM的训练速度最高可提升6倍，峰值内存使用最多可减少2倍，同时……
tldr: 提出梯度提升框架GB-CPKM，通过顺序添加固定秩CP张量网络学习器来增量式提升模型容量，从而避免显式秩搜索，实现最高6倍的训练加速和2倍的峰值内存节省。
